# 报告者作用域；本模块借用军事官署夹具后调用。恢复是否精确由用例直接断言 scope:tca_mcp_restore_exact。
# 军事夹具的失败 flag 只在夹具边界清理，不能泄漏为经验用例的第二套结果状态。
tca_test_experience_cleanup_effect = {
    # 跨年时自然补入的文官也可能持有模块保护；正式释放本署锁后才能让通用夹具撤内阁。
    # 只释放本署拥有的锁，不删除外部保护变量，不改变正常玩法的任免逻辑。
    scope:tca_mcp_governor ?= {
        cp:councillor_marshal ?= { tca_military_release_council_lock_effect = { OWNER = scope:tca_mcp_governor } }
        cp:councillor_chancellor ?= { tca_military_release_council_lock_effect = { OWNER = scope:tca_mcp_governor } }
    }
    tca_test_military_council_cleanup_effect = yes
    remove_character_flag = tca_test_tca_military_court_positions_test_case_failed
}
